protocol.baseline_targets: draft (owner to confirm): hybrid >= +10% nDCG@10 over text-only; abstention precision >= 0.95; answer recall >= 0.90; citation resolution = 1.0
protocol.citation_definition: fraction of emitted citations whose segment_id resolves to an existing segment with a non-empty locator

no_backend.note: No LLM backend configured in this environment; the system abstains on every answerable item. This is the honest degraded-mode measurement.

oracle_stub.note: Deterministic stub cites the real top retrieved segment; measures the citation/provenance pipeline, not model quality.
